info.title: MBANK Business Analytics reporting contract
info.description: Administrator management reporting, aggregate-only snapshots and audited exports. This contract prepares a future Go service; it does not implement a ledger, warehouse ingestion or payment processing.

get.summary: Read aggregate financial and operational reporting snapshot

200.description: Immutable aggregate snapshot with explicit source coverage.

422.description: Invalid scope, incomplete coverage or invalid reporting data.

post.summary: Authorize and durably audit an export of the reviewed snapshot

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Must equal request_id and be bound to authenticated actor, snapshot, scope, format, purpose and checksum.

200.description: Durable audit request receipt; does not attest browser download completion.

422.description: Invalid scope, incomplete coverage or invalid reporting data.

sessionCookie.name: session
sessionCookie.description: Authenticated Go session cookie; deployment name is configurable. Frontend requests use credentials: include. Mock browser role checks are not server authorization.

BusinessAcquisitionCohort.description: One attributed channel per registration. Outcomes are measured at report cutoff and are overlapping subsets, not same-day funding events.

BusinessAnalyticsReport.description: Daily reporting rollups sized by bounded date/category dimensions, independent of total customer count. Include complete current/comparison periods and opening balances; never return individual user profiles.

BusinessFilters.description: Inclusive complete UTC days, at most 90 selected days within the latest 90 report days. Adjacent equal-length comparison and opening balances must be available.

OperationalSnapshot.description: Current operational aggregates, separate from warehouse financial cutoffs. Wallet transfer activity uses the stated trailing initiation window; monetary positions retain their own units.

BusinessSnapshot.description: Immutable reporting snapshot. The HTTP service must return mode=live and financial_basis=BOOKED_WAREHOUSE. Source observation/report cutoffs cannot exceed snapshot as_of. Only declare CONSISTENT_CUTOFF when guaranteed by backend data authorities.

BusinessExportRequest.description: Export the reviewed snapshot. Actor comes exclusively from the authenticated server session. Content checksum identifies prepared client content, not an independent audit opinion or proof of download completion.

BusinessExportReceipt.description: Return only after durable audit evidence and payload-bound idempotency receipt are saved in one transaction. All echoed identifiers and checksum must match the request.
